description:
Priority: P1 | Area: agent | Labels: feat,area:agent,P1 | Milestone: v0.1.0 | RFC: none (v0.1 profile) | Task: AI-0009

Implements bitty-ai#11. Single bitty-ai-runtime crate skeleton per docs/specifications/implementation-profile-v0.1.md (draft CTX-0015, dual-APPROVE draft-scope): provider/context/session/tool/agent/stream modules, deterministic FakeProvider, single-agent loop with cancel/tool-dispatch/context/streaming. Cross-repo note: profile merges separately; this task tracks the draft content.

Hard limits: no network providers, no secrets, no five-crate split, no L2+ compaction, no multi-agent, no bitty-ai-core rename beyond what the skeleton needs (keep placeholder untouched unless the skeleton replaces it — prefer additive). bitty-ai-slice stays green unmodified; add fail-closed tests (cancellation, budget, Unknown). MSRV 1.85, edition 2024, workspace lints, justfile gates only.

Acceptance: just check + cargo test --workspace --all-targets --locked + act -n pass; independent review; stop in_review, no merge.
title: Implement bitty-ai-runtime skeleton with deterministic single-agent loop
